Remotely related also {{cog|nl|-}} and {{cog|de|kennen}}, {{cog|fy|kenne}} (see English {{m|en|ken}}). * from Indo-European: {{cog|la|gnoscō}}, {{cog|la|cognoscō}} ({{cog|es|conocer}}, {{cog|fr|connaître}}, {{cog|ro|cunoaște}}, {{cog|it|conoscere}}, {{cog|pt|conhecer}}), {{cog|grc|γνωρίζω||to know}} and {{m|grc|γνῶσις||knowledge}}, {{cog|sq|njoh||to know, recognise}}, {{cog|ru|знать||to know}}, {{cog|lt|žinoti||to know}}, {{cog|fa|شناختن|tr=šenâxtan||to know}} and {{cog|hi|जानना||to know, understand}}. {{col-bottom}} ====Alternative forms==== * {{alt|en|knaa||Northumbrian}} * {{alter|en|knowe||obsolete}} ====Verb==== {{en-verb|~s|~ing|knew,~ed|~n,knew}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[perceive]] the [[truth]] or [[factuality]] of; to be certain of; to be certain that. #* {{quote-av |en |date=4/17/1985 |author=w:Frank Herbert |title=Frank Herbert speaking at UCLA 4/17/1985 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170210174612/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5IfgBX1EW00 |archivedate=10 February 2017 |publisher=UCLACommStudies |time=15:46 |text=Question things.
